extension.description: This table presents the global supply and use relationships of 64 products (CPA); the data cover the period from 2022 onwards and distinguish 27 EU Member States, 2 EFTA countries, 5 EU candidate countries, 15 main EU trading partners and a ‘Rest of the world’ region.
